title: GeoTour Uzbekistan: open-data tourism screening model, results and geoportal source (v1.1)
description:
Code, 1 km input rasters, results and the main portal source of the GeoTour Uzbekistan open-data screening model, published in the geoportal https://geotour-uzbekistan.uz.

Four indices (ESI, TSI, TPI, TRSI) on a 1 km equal-area grid (EPSG:6933, 438,100 km² of assessed land), computed from OpenStreetMap, ESA WorldCover 2021 and Copernicus DEM GLO-90 with a weighted geometric mean and weights midway between equal and entropy weights; per-cell class stability and uncertainty range from a 500-run Monte Carlo experiment; a Sobol variance decomposition; a road-network distance test; a demand-side check against official regional accommodation statistics; an ESI sensitivity test with OpenStreetMap protected areas; a monthly climate comfort layer from TerraClimate 1991–2020 normals; lab measurements of portal load performance; a check of how current the OpenStreetMap point extract is; and an independent test against 31,219 geotagged Wikimedia Commons photographs (photo-user-days by place and month).

This is a screening without expert calibration or field validation. Code: MIT licence. Derived data keep the licences of their sources (OpenStreetMap: ODbL 1.0; ESA WorldCover: CC BY 4.0; TerraClimate: CC0 1.0; Copernicus DEM: produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-90 © DLR e.V. 2010–2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014–2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved).
